name: optcatalog_create_trail_segment_node_from_template
description: OptCatalog::CreateTrailSegmentNodeFromTemplate allocates an active Object3D parent node and optionally attaches the supplied template node as its child.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog trail-runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b2130 validates ECX as templateNode, gwObject3DInit allocation, gwNodeSetActive(parent, 1), optional gwObject3DAddChild(parent, templateNode), and returning the new parent node.
The native OptCatalog smoke verifies active Object3D parent allocation, template child attachment/list linkage, and the null-template path.
